Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Protection | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: OCR-080-r0a | Equipment:
 Overcurrent and Earth Leakage Protection Device and SC
 REJ 525
 ABB
Issued to: 
 Distribution Companies
Status: 
 Draft
Approval date: 2009 | Procedure:
 Using a secondary injection device
Next review date: 2014
Introduction
The B 415 BAA REJ 525 device performs many functions, including overcurrent and earth leakage protection, short-circuit and phase discontinuity protection, fault recorders, and current, voltage and power measurements, etc.
This document was prepared by Canal Electricity Distribution Company and was reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the distribution companies.
Safety Precautions
Notify the competent control/operation of the cells on which the protection is to be tested.
Notify the competent control/operation of the cells on which the protection is to be tested.
Issue an approved work order specifying the work location and the work team, observing occupational safety and health rules.
The work team must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
The work team must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Ensure warning signs are posted on the cell to be worked on.
Ensure the circuit breaker is switched off and withdrawn outside the cell.
Do not open current transformer terminals while in service or under test.
Ensure the protection device is earthed.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Secondary injection device with its accessories (with current injection leads and Trip leads for recording the tripping time), e.g. SVERKER 760 secondary injection device.
A source for supplying the injection device with 220 VAC.
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: 
 Overcurrent Characteristic Test with a 5 Ampere Secondary Winding
Test values shall be determined and the devices programmed to operate on them according to the values and times agreed with the transmission companies (transformer station), so that the tripping time on outgoing feeders does not exceed 0.15 seconds | 1.
The REJ 525 protection device shall be supplied with the appropriate operating voltage (charger output voltage) on the panel at points (1, 2) on the terminal block (X 2.1) on the device | 2.
The phase discontinuity DI characteristic on the device shall be switched off | 3.
The injection device current leads shall be connected to the terminals of the first phase R of the protection device at points (5, 2) on the terminal block (X 1.1) on the device | 4.
The injection current value shall be increased gradually until reaching the rated value I pick up, and tripping shall be effected by the protection device | 5.
Record this value I pick up and set the injection device to retain this value, switching off the injection process | 6.
Connect the Trip leads of the protection device, points (3, 4) on the terminal block (X 2.1), to the timer points on the injection device to record the tripping time | 7.
Inject the protection device with the stored current value in one shot by switching on + TIME for the injection process and record the tripping time | 8.
Repeat the above with phase S at points (8, 2) on the terminal block (X 1.1) on the device, and likewise with phase T at points (11, 2) on the terminal block (X 1.1) on the device | 9.
The reset factor shall be calculated by reducing the secondary injection current gradually until reset of the protection device occurs, then record this current value, then calculate the reset factor from the formula KRF = I reset / I pick up | 10.
Short-circuit unit SC element test: after setting the rated value of the short-circuit current and its instantaneous time, raise the injection current value to the rated current value of the short-circuit unit (20:30 amp/secondary) until the short-circuit unit operates; the time shall be instantaneous. Note: the protection device delay time must be taken into account during setting | 11.
Second: 
 Earth Leakage Characteristic Test
Test values shall be determined and the devices programmed to operate on them according to the values and times agreed with the transmission companies (transformer station), so that the tripping time on outgoing feeders does not exceed 0.15 seconds | 1.
The REJ 525 protection device shall be supplied with the appropriate operating voltage (charger output voltage) on the panel at points (1, 2) on the terminal block (X 2.1) on the device | 2.
Connect the injection device current leads to the terminals of the REJ 525 protection device for the leakage winding at points (1, 2) on the terminal block (X 1.1) on the device | 3.
The injection current value shall be increased gradually until reaching the rated value I pick up, and tripping shall be effected by the protection device | 4.
Record this value I pick up and set the injection device to retain this value, switching off the injection process | 5.
Connect the Trip leads of the protection device, points (3, 4) on the terminal block (X 2.1), to the timer points on the injection device; inject the protection device with the stored current value in one shot by switching on TIME+ on for the injection process to record the tripping time | 6.
Lower the current gradually until reaching the I reset value of the protection device and record this value | 7.
Calculate the reset factor from the formula KRF = I reset / I pick up | 8.
To activate the short-circuit unit for earth of the earth leakage device, raise the current value above the rated current of the first stage (First stage) while reducing the time to instantaneous | 9.
All characteristics that were previously switched off shall be reactivated | 10.
TRIP
